r1_hypothesis.predicted_if_right: Runtime user cannot create a new sibling in the trusted directory but can rewrite its own existing predecessor file.
r1_hypothesis.predicted_if_wrong: The write to the existing predecessor fails solely because the parent directory is root-owned/non-writable.

r3_counter_reality.counterhypothesis: Trusted parent-directory ownership/write bits automatically protect all existing sibling contents regardless of each file's owner/mode.
